name: Existing Board Import
description: Import the existing board state (all campaigns, missions, lanes, tasks) into PGlite. Verify completeness.
purpose: The current board is the acceptance test.
acceptanceCriteria: All existing campaigns from docs/json/omp/campaigns/ are imported
